# Load one workbook preserving formulas for writing, and one data_only workbook
# for reading cached displayed values from formula/spill cells such as column C.
wb = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=False)
wb_values = load_workbook(spreadsheet_path, data_only=True)

ws = wb.active
ws_values = wb_values[ws.title]

# Dynamically detect real used extent of column A.
last_a = 1
for r in range(ws_values.max_row, 1, -1):
    if ws_values.cell(r, 1).value not in (None, ""):
        last_a = r
        break

# Collect distinct nonblank values from column A.
unique_values_in_a = set()
for r in range(2, last_a + 1):
    v = ws_values.cell(r, 1).value
    if v not in (None, ""):
        unique_values_in_a.add(v)

        return ("ArrayFormula", getattr(v, "ref", None), getattr(v, "text", None))
    return v

changed_outside = []
max_row = max(in_ws.max_row, out_ws.max_row)
max_col = max(in_ws.max_column, out_ws.max_column)

for r in range(1, max_row + 1):
    for c in range(1, max_col + 1):
        if (r, c) in answer_cells:

assert non_empty == 4, "Not all cells in D2:D5 were filled."
